scope: Fiscal screens and contextual quick catalog; integration with shared UI maintained by the root agent.
review_method: Owned CSS cascade and duplicate-declaration inspection
Targeted presentation and fiscal workflow tests
Browser validation recorded separately by visual_browser_matrix agent

findings.problem: NF-e had its own green header, buttons, tabs, field borders and footer overriding shared ERP components.
findings.correction: Removed the separate skins; shared component stylesheet now controls appearance. Existing field IDs, conditional visibility, submit actions and validation remain intact.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Several repeated control declarations fixed dimensions or small type locally.
findings.correction: Removed generic input/select/button appearance overrides and used shared height, border and typography tokens for domain-specific read-only fields.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Historic append-only rules repeated or overrode the same selectors and properties.
findings.correction: Removed shadowed declarations within the same media scope, retaining form grids, disclosure geometry and mobile variants.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Two competing modal implementations defined different widths, radii, overflow behavior, headers and control heights.
findings.correction: Removed the obsolete skin and retained a single viewport-bounded editor grid; central dialog/header/footer/control styling is inherited.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: New-registration action used a module-specific visual button.
findings.correction: Added shared btn btn-secondary classes without changing its ID or event handler.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Result rows and search popovers mixed 36/37px rows, 11px detail text and hardcoded control radius/focus.
findings.correction: Standardized minimum result height and readable typography using shared tokens; preserved yellow result focus, top-layer positioning and keyboard behavior.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Manifestation selectors were 30px high with 3px corners and 11px text, unlike equivalent ERP fields.
findings.correction: Selectors use the shared 38px height, 4px radius and 13.5px font; disabled/focus and manifestation confirmation behavior remain.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Table action icons were 28px while standard icon buttons are 32px; superseded minimum widths impeded layout.
findings.correction: Use shared icon-button size and remove superseded manifestation widths while keeping document table scrolling inside its container.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Inline layout styles were repeated across configuration, tax groups, rules, FCP, cancellation and inutilization views.
findings.correction: Moved 27 inline style attributes and the catalog inline style block into fiscal-workspace.css without transferring generic component skins.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Filter-submit height was 36px while adjacent inputs use 38px.
findings.correction: Shared field-height token aligns action with neighboring fields; responsive filter grid is preserved.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

findings.problem: Item total labels had a fixed dark foreground within the shared colored dialog header.
findings.correction: Use inherited header foreground for total labels and amounts to preserve contrast.
findings.status: implemented; browser validation in shared matrix

deliberate_variants.reason: Regulated print geometry is preserved, including nfce-danfe.blade.php and nfce-danfe-wait.blade.php.
Domain-specific field layout is retained; component appearance is shared.
820px maximum width and viewport-bounded internal scroll are a functional editor size, not a separate visual skin.
Document columns keep a 950px minimum width within .table-scroll to prevent key, currency and action clipping; horizontal scroll remains contained.
Two-line suggestions grow naturally beyond the shared minimum height; yellow focus state and keyboard interactions are preserved.
Functional circular/indicator geometry is intentionally preserved.

business_changes: None: no fiscal calculations, controllers, services, emission JS, credentials or authorized-document data changed.
